case_title: JOHN L KIRK VS. GINGER HAMILTON

docket_entries.description: PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE WAS $50.00 SERVED JUL-21-2025, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT HAMILTON, GINGER

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-13-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-13-2025 BY VISITING JUDGE TAMILA IPEMA. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF JOHN L KIRK IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GINGER HAMILTON IS PRESENT. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-13-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KIRK, JOHN L IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HAMILTON, GINGER PARTIES MADE A VERBAL CONTRACT - LANDLORD PLAINTIFF AGREED TO GIVE A DISCONTIN RENT WITH THE COVEAT THAT DEFENDANT HAS TO MOVE OUT IN 25 MONTHS. DEFENDANT AGREED BUT FAILED TO MOVE OUT DUE TO HER SERIOUS HEALTH CONDITION. PLAINTIFF LANDLORD DOES NOT WISH TO EVICT THE DEFENDANT DUE TO HER HEALTH CONDITION. LANDLORD PLAINTIFF IS SEEKING TO GET THE DISCOUNTED AMOUNT FOR THE ENTIRE 25 MONTHS BACK FROM THE DEFENDANT. LANDLORD NEVER TOLD DEFENDANT TENANT THAT IF SHE DOES NOT MOVE OUT...SEE ATTACHMENT STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $11,477.50 FILED BY KIRK, JOHN L AS TO DEFENDANT HAMILTON, GINGER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-13-2025 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
